Target size follows the 'Chosen' canvas (40px pills, 46x28 switches) rather than the >= 44px floor in h8; this departure is not recorded as a deviation.
d3: the engine node daemon (culture_rules/node, t41) was added; this production code runs placed/unplaced triggers.
d2: secrets are sealed with grant instead of shushu.
The bundle is served under the /api prefix alongside the bare API (test_api_is_reachable_bare_and_under_the_api_prefix).
Steps are toggled, edited and deleted through the workflow document (workflows update), not through step-level CLI/MCP verbs.
The endpoint shipped as GET /machines/status (not /machines/stats), and the tab is a one-shot load rather than live-refreshed.
POST /replay HTTP route and 'rules replay' CLI verb (integration addition).
Repo-backed export/import HTTP routes and the repo picker in the Workflows tab (integration addition).
d2: references are grant:<NAME> resolved with grant get, replacing shushu.
d1: Rule.placement uses the same three forms for where a rule evaluates.
Citations to the scope entries were placed in the README Background, not in the spec's background paragraph.
The demo was executed on one host with simulated redundancy, not on the three hosts.
The topology adds orin as the third voting, data-bearing member and makes spark2 non-voting (votes 0, priority 0); the announcement names only spark, thor and spark2.
Live fan-out exists only at the API (SSE); the shipped editor fetches on load and never receives pushed updates.
purge (admin-only, permanent removal of tombstoned items) is an integration addition.
GET /asks list route used by the Rules tab's in-context asks panel (integration addition).
Supersession skips are not persisted to any rule history; only replay reports the 'superseded by' reason.
visible control sizes follow the design canvas (40px pills, 46x28 switches, 15px secondary text) with >=44x44px invisible hit areas, instead of h8's literal 16px/44px
the engine node re-evaluates must_after/may_after dependants when a predecessor's run settles (chain consumers), persists rule decisions (rule_decisions) and exposes GET /rules/{id}/history
